fieldValues.title: Dissent in agent decisions is lost before the revisit
fieldValues.statement: When an agent reviewer dissents from a decision, or a builder accepts a review finding instead of fixing it, the disagreement is written only into a pull request comment or body. Nothing ties it to the decision it disagrees with, so when that decision's revisit trigger fires, I see the decision and its rationale but not the objections raised against it in operation, and I cannot tell whether the trigger was already being warned about.
source_ref: clerk/routines/wg-reviewer.md step 10 (dissent as one line of a quorum comment)
